gloss: to get drunk; to get intoxicated; to get motion sick

definitions.gloss: to get drunk; to become intoxicated
definitions.explanation: To become affected by alcohol. Describes the state of being under the influence of alcoholic drinks.

definitions.gloss: to get motion sick; to feel nauseous from motion
definitions.explanation: To feel sick from the rocking or movement of a vehicle, boat, or other transport.

definitions.gloss: to be intoxicated; to be entranced
definitions.explanation: To be deeply absorbed or captivated by something beautiful, exciting, or pleasurable. A figurative extension of the intoxication meaning.

examples.japanese: ビールを{三杯|さんばい}{飲|の}んで{酔|よ}った。
examples.english: I got drunk after three beers.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{酔|よ}うと{陽気|ようき}になる。
examples.english: He becomes cheerful when he gets drunk.

examples.japanese: お{酒|さけ}に{酔|よ}って、{終電|しゅうでん}を{逃|のが}してしまった。
examples.english: I got drunk and missed the last train.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}に{酔|よ}いやすい{人|ひと}は{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んでおいたほうがいい。
examples.english: People who get seasick easily should take medicine beforehand.

examples.japanese: {長時間|ちょうじかん}のバスで{酔|よ}って{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}くなった。
examples.english: I got motion sick and felt nauseous from the long bus ride.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{音楽|おんがく}に{酔|よ}った。
examples.english: I was entranced by the beautiful music.

examples.japanese: {勝利|しょうり}に{酔|よ}いしれて{油断|ゆだん}してはいけない。
examples.english: You must not let your guard down by getting intoxicated with victory.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{言葉|ことば}に{酔|よ}っている{人|ひと}は{信用|しんよう}できない。
examples.english: You can't trust people who are intoxicated by their own words.

notes:
Godan verb. Conjugates as {酔|よ}う・{酔|よ}って・{酔|よ}った. The particle に marks the cause of intoxication or motion sickness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{酒|さけ}に{酔|よ}う (to get drunk on alcohol)
- {車|くるま}に{酔|よ}う (to get carsick)
- {船|ふね}に{酔|よ}う (to get seasick)
- ～に{酔|よ}いしれる (to be intoxicated/entranced by ~)
- {酔|よ}いが{回|まわ}る (the alcohol goes to one's head)
- {酔|よ}いが{覚|さ}める (to sober up)

The te-form {酔|よ}って is often used as an adjective meaning "drunk." The related noun {酔|よ}い means "drunkenness" or "intoxication." For motion sickness, ～{酔|よ}い forms compounds: {車酔|くるまよ}い (carsickness), {船酔|ふなよ}い (seasickness).
